messages:
sylvia: Quick kickoff for a narrow pricing experiment next week. Plan: 1) swap tier names (two simple families), 2) tiny calculator card under tiers (no lead capture on first pass), 3) abridged FAQ (4 Qs). Launch behind flag `pricing_calc_v1`. Goal: clearer choices and +0.4pp trial conversion.

hassan: +1. For tier names well test Benefit-led vs Functional. Keep bullets to 3 words.

nick: Dev note: calculator card will call `/api/estimate-v1`. Feature flag = pricing_calc_v1. Events: `pricing:card_open`, `pricing:estimate_run`, `pricing:estimate_submit`. No lead POST unless user clicks "Talk to sales".

tara: Copy: I'll do 4 FAQ one-liners and a micro-benchmark (5-dev chat app example). Draft by Mon EOD. Also add a tooltip showing per-token math.

sylvia: Metrics: primary = trial-start rate. Secondary = card opens and estimator submits. Baseline conv 3.3% -> target +0.4pp. Add experiment_key `pricing_calc_v1` in page context.

deploy-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood/pricing-calc-3612345678 (flag enabled).

hassan: Routing for "Talk to sales": if estimated_arr >= 30k -> sales-inbound else nurture-sdr. Include `lead_source=pricing_card`. Also send `user_country` and `consent_state`.

sylvia: Launch: Wed 09:00 PT, 25% traffic, run 10 days, then quick retro. Keep copy/design/dev sync tomorrow 10:30. Thanks :rocket:
